record.question: Which of the following statement(s) is/are correct in connection with the election of Vice President of India in 2025? (i) The office of Vice President of India has fallen vacant in view of the Notification of the Lok Sabha Secretariat on 22.7.2025. (ii) For the 17th Vice Presidential Election in 2025, the electoral college comprises of a total of 788 members of both Houses of Parliament. (iii) A candidate can file maximum of four (4) nomination papers. (iv) The security deposit for the election is 20,000/-.
record.explanation: Answer B: Only (ii) and (iii). The Election Commission release attributes the 22 July 2025 vacancy notification to the Ministry of Home Affairs, not the Lok Sabha Secretariat; statement(i) is false. The electoral college total is 788 and a candidate may file at most four nomination papers, so (ii) and (iii) are true. The deposit is Rs 15,000, not Rs 20,000, so (iv) is false. Only (ii) and (iii) matches option B. Reference: https://www.pib.gov.in/Pressreleaseshare.aspx?PRID=2151311&lang=2&reg=48. Verified worked solution, unofficial. Historical context: October 2025 examination (cover page); answer time-sensitive wording as of then.. Officeholders, survey results and forecasts refer to that original paper, not necessarily the present. No matching examiner key is asserted.
